title: Abstract completed integral models on normal Noetherian schemes
statement: Let $T$ be a Noetherian separated scheme [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] such that every stalk of its structure sheaf is an integrally closed domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]. Let $\ell$ be a prime invertible in all these stalks and let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite, with valuation ring $A$ and recorded uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. On the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] set $B_T=\varprojlim_{n\ge1}(A/\varpi^n)_T$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], and let $s$ be the image of the constant $\varpi$ section under the canonical constant-to-completion map. For every locally finite free $B_T[1/s]$-module sheaf $L$ [def-weil-pbc-ringed-section-localization, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], there is a locally finite free $B_T$-module sheaf $M$ and an isomorphism $B_T[1/s]\otimes_{B_T}M\cong L$. This asserts an abstract integral model, with no embedding in $L$ and no injectivity assertion. Site and coefficient universes are independent, with values in a common containing universe. The empty scheme and locally varying rank, including rank zero, are allowed.

proof.text: The underlying space is Noetherian, hence has finitely many open connected components by the two cited Noetherian results. Their complements are unions of the other open components, so they are clopen. Each open component is Noetherian; its stalks, separation and invertibility hypotheses are inherited from $T$. Restriction identifies its completed coefficients and uniformizer with those on $T$ by the clopen gluing lemma. Localization at the constant uniformizer also restricts: by [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-localization-restriction], applied to the arrow from the component to the terminal object $T$, the restriction of $B_T[1/s]$ is $(B_T|_{X_i})[1/s|_{X_i}]$, hence the localized completed coefficients of the component. Empty $T$ uses its empty-product clause.

source.place: Tags 04MF, 04ME and 0052, the Noetherian connected-component decomposition; Bhatt-Scholze Lemmas 7.4.7 and 7.4.10 for the reduction to connected bases

proof.text: On a nonempty component $X$, choose a geometric point using an algebraic closure of a residue field. By [lem-a1-normal-proetale-monodromy], $L|_X$ corresponds to a continuous representation $V$ of the profinite etale fundamental group. Apply [lem-pod-profinite-stable-lattice] to obtain a stable finite free lattice $\Lambda$ spanning $V$, with continuous restricted action. Rank $\dim_E V=0$ is included.

Apply [lem-a1-lattice-residue-system-realization] to obtain the coherent normalized tower and its locally free completed limit $N_\Lambda$. The normalization clause of [lem-a1-normal-proetale-monodromy] gives $N_\Lambda[1/\varpi]\cong L|_X$. The coefficient isomorphisms of [lem-sfb-integral-lisse-reduction-equivalence] identify the continuous coefficients with the displayed completion; inverting $\ell$ or $\varpi$ agrees since $\ell$ is a unit times a positive power of $\varpi$ in $A$.

Glue by $M(U)=\prod_iN_i(U\times_T X_i)$ using [lem-pur-clopen-ringed-module-gluing]. The component free covers cover $M$, with varying ranks allowed. Apply $a_{i,F,H}$ of [lem-pur-clopen-total-tensor-kflat-detection] with $R=B_T$, $F=B_T[1/s]$, $H=M$: it sends $b\otimes m$ to $r_i b\otimes r_i m$. With the restricted coefficients and uniformizer from step 2, this identifies the component rationalization with $N_i[1/\varpi]$. The component isomorphisms and inverses glue by the module equivalence to $B_T[1/s]\otimes_{B_T}M\cong L$. Zero ranks give zero models; the empty partition gives the empty case. Undo step 1.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_normal_completed_integral_model
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type v) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] [T.IsSeparated]
    (hnormal : ∀ x : T,
      IsDomain (T.presheaf.stalk x) ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed (T.presheaf.stalk x))
    (hl : ∀ x : T, IsUnit (l : T.presheaf.stalk x))
    (s : ((WeilConjectures.completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T).obj ⋙
      forget CommRingCat).sections)
    (hs : ∀ U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ, s.val U =
      ((WeilConjectures.integralConstantToCompletionOfUniverses l E T).hom.app U)
        ((toSheafify (Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
          ((Functor.const T.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj
            (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))))).app U
              (ULift.up (Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E))))
    (L : ringedSiteModules.{max v (u + 1)}
      ((sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max v (u + 1)} RingCat.{max v (u + 1)})).obj
        (ringedLocalizationRingOfUniverses.{max v (u + 1), u + 1, u}
          (WeilConjectures.completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T) s)))
    (hL : L.IsFiniteLocallyFree) :
    ∃ M : ringedSiteModules.{max v (u + 1)}
        (WeilConjectures.completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E T),
      M.IsFiniteLocallyFree ∧
      Nonempty (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsOfUniverses.{u, u + 1,
        max v (u + 1), max v (u + 1)}
        (ringedLocalizationRingUnitOfUniverses.{max v (u + 1), u + 1, u}
          (WeilConjectures.completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T) s) M ≅ L)
